# Projectvision

> Projectvision is an Australian development-led property company based in Silverwater / Newington, NSW, combining development management, in-house architecture, project management, and construction under single-line accountability. Established in 1999.

## Core Capabilities
- **Development Management**: Feasibility, site acquisition advice, financial modelling, yield optimization, joint venture structuring.
- **In-House Architecture & Design**: Concept design, DA/CDC approvals, construction documentation, tenancy design guidelines.
- **Mainstream Project Management**: Authority approvals, superintendent roles, procurement, contractor selection, programming, cost control.
- **Construction & Building Management**: Turnkey delivery, buildability review, cost certainty, quality control, safe handover.
- **Tenancy Coordination**: Retail fitout management, design reviews, handover coordination across major national tenancies.

## Sectors Delivered
- Commercial Office Buildings & Corporate Fitouts
- Retail Centres, Neighbourhood Malls & Bulky Goods
- Residential & Mixed-Use Developments
- Industrial Warehouses & Logistics Hubs
- Service Stations, Fuel Forecourts & Quick Service Restaurants (QSR)
- Hospitality & Hotels

## Executive Leadership
- **Branko Poljak** (Co-Founder): Property industry since 1990. Extensive background in building services engineering, detailed design, conceptual services, authority management, and project direction across retail, commercial, residential, hotels, and industrial segments.
- **Amitav Goswami** (Co-Founder): Architectural & property industry since 1982. Transitioned to project management in 1996. Specialized in corporate strategy alignment, design management, business strategy development, and commercial construction.

## Representative Projects
- **The Hub Gregory Hills**: 16,500m² retail and commercial centre delivery.
- **Narellan Town Centre Expansion**: Major retail expansion and tenancy management.
- **Oran Park Podium**: Retail, medical, and community hub integration.
- **Rydalmere Industrial Hub**: High-bay distribution centre with integrated corporate offices.
- **Stockland Baringa**: Masterplanned neighbourhood centre with supermarket and specialty retail.
- **Oxford Street Epping**: Multi-unit mixed-use residential and commercial retail development.
- **EG Caltex / Woolworths Service Station**: Multi-bay fuel forecourt and convenience retail development.
